title: The Master Gunner's Log
text:
Day of the Sealing. The Synod says powder is vanity: a fire men made, instead of the fire God gave. They have bricked up the stores and left us in them.

I have forty kegs, three boys, a mule, and the great gun. I have more powder than the Order has prayers.

Later, shakier: The boys have gone black from the dust. They laugh at nothing. The mule will not stop walking into the walls. I keep the gun clean. Somebody will come down the stair one day, and when they do, I will give them a salute.
